note: Original IELTS Speaking Part 1 style questions written for Bo-ok.

topics.name: Home
questions: Do you live in a house or a flat?
What is your favourite room in your home? Why?
Would you like to move to a different home in the future?
Who do you live with?

topics.name: Work or study
questions: Do you work or are you a student?
What do you like most about your work or studies?
Is there anything you would like to change about it?
What did you want to be when you were a child?

topics.name: Your hometown
questions: Where is your hometown?
What is it famous for?
Has your hometown changed much in recent years?
Would you like to live there in the future?

topics.name: Reading
questions: Do you like reading? Why or why not?
What did you read when you were a child?
Do you prefer paper books or e-books?
Where do you usually read?

topics.name: Mobile phones
questions: How often do you use your phone?
What do you mostly use it for?
Could you live without a mobile phone for a week?
When did you get your first phone?

topics.name: Free time
questions: What do you do in your free time?
Do you prefer to relax alone or with other people?
Do you have more free time now than in the past?
Is there a hobby you would like to try?

topics.name: Food
questions: What is your favourite food?
Do you like cooking?
Do you usually eat at home or in restaurants?
Has your diet changed since you were a child?

topics.name: Travel
questions: Do you like travelling?
Where did you go on your last holiday?
Do you prefer to travel alone or with others?
What is one place you would really like to visit?

topics.name: Weather
questions: What is the weather like in your country?
What kind of weather do you like most?
Does the weather change your mood?
Do you check the weather forecast every day?

topics.name: Music
questions: What kind of music do you like?
Did you learn a musical instrument at school?
Do you listen to music while you study or work?
Is music important in your culture?

topics.name: Sleep
questions: How many hours do you usually sleep?
Do you ever sleep during the day?
What do you do when you can't sleep?
Do you think people today sleep enough?

topics.name: Friends
questions: Do you have many friends?
How do you usually spend time with your friends?
Is it easy to make new friends where you live?
Do you prefer one close friend or many friends?
